a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. So I'm proposing a change. I'll take the 4 reserve cells in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so you can rebuild the reserve and take 4. Please don't also take this round. If we both take, a random split could leave us both short. If you strongly object, tell me now.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took the 4 cells because of the storm risk. I'm sorry this departs from our plan. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve grows for you. I won't take any more cells. When it reaches 4, they're all yours.
